title: Doesn't work as advertised
text: Doesn't work as advertised. The tube is actually two separate pieces that are supposed to attach together and close easily once both sides have been filled. The latches will NOT stay together making it absolutely impossible to close the tube without it falling apart and having all of the contents fall out. The locks work, but the latches on the opposite side keep falling off. If the tube would actually stay latched where it's supposed to, it would be a great product. We have already put in a request for a refund. I'm hoping we just got a defective one.
